name: Herm's Inn (Logan) "Inside-Out" Sriracha-Black-Bean Grilled Cheese & "Macho" (Avoid)
searchKeywords: herms inn inside out grilled cheese
diners drive ins and dives logan
whyItWorks: Featured on Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives, but the Inside-Out Grilled Cheese (stuffed with black beans, guacamole, and Sriracha) and the Macho (chorizo and green chile) are flare bombs.
prepOrOrderInstructions: If ordering a grilled cheese at Herm's Inn, ask for a plain Cheddar/Swiss Grilled Cheese on sourdough with no Sriracha and no black beans.
watchOuts: Sriracha hot sauce, spicy pork chorizo, pork chile verde, and whole black beans
